essential_scope: Endpoint specified-column success is different from existence of some column. Extension counts vary matrices and are not instructional-class weights in a fixed matrix.
The sparse family exists for every m>=2, has exactly m complete words and m singleton classes, and is balanced. It is an infinite subclass, not a pressing counterexample.
The moving-block balance criterion requires the entire uniformly sampled successful language.
The weighted identity fixes one ordered quadruple and every target cross-pair; its prefix-set contexts are disjoint.
The two-thirds coverage hypothesis is sufficient and conditional; it is not proved universally or necessary.
F and G preserve zero counts for inaccessible or uncompletable principal sets.
The abstract four-word obstruction is closed for complete singleton-addition chains, not arbitrary maximal inclusion-poset chains.
review_meaning: AI-assisted, unrefereed mathematics. Independent internal AI mathematical audits are not external human peer review, journal acceptance, formal proof certification or priority clearance.
excluded: Programs, raw per-case matrix collections/results/certificates, source documents or source-text copies, private sources, personal data and coordination records. Small authored proof matrices and exact finite counterexamples remain mathematical content.
